source: zajca/pohunek#883 (2026-10-12): live session on Claude Code 2.1.288 (macOS, auto mode), controlled reproduction R1-R4 on Claude Code 2.1.295 (Linux), and the background_tasks construction read from the Claude Code 2.1.296 binary (issue intake comment)

format.events: Ordered SubagentStart, SubagentStop and main-agent Stop hook inputs. A SubagentStart or SubagentStop is sanitized to hook_event_name, agent_id and agent_type. A main-agent Stop carries no agent_id; it is sanitized to hook_event_name and background_tasks, whose entries keep id, type and status plus the description, agent_type and command fields Claude sends beside them, so a replay can show that the state hook drops them. `at` is the UTC time the issue records, where it records one. The R1-R3 and live sequences leave their main-agent Stop events out; the R4 sequences carry them at the turn ends their descriptions name.
format.checkpoints: Rows expected after the first `after_events` events.
format.final_rows: Rows expected after every event: one row per subagent, with its lifecycle.

ids: Ids the issue records in full are kept. The reproduction logged ids only in truncated form, so R1-R4 and every prompt-suggestion helper use synthetic ids of the same shape (`a` plus 16 hex digits). Shell and teammate task ids are synthetic too; a teammate's agent id has Claude's `name@team` form and differs from its task id.

spawn_handback_resume.description: Two unnamed run_in_background general-purpose agents are spawned in one turn, both hand back, then SendMessage resumes the first one: SubagentStart fires again with the same agent_id and agent_type, and SubagentStop ends the resumed run.

self_wake.description: A background agent starts its own run_in_background shell and hands back at once (SubagentStop). When the shell finishes, Claude resumes the agent by itself: SubagentStart and SubagentStop fire again with the same agent_id.

helper_stop_after_each_turn.description: About 1-3 s after every main-agent Stop, the prompt-suggestion helper sends a SubagentStop with a fresh agent_id, agent_type "" and no preceding SubagentStart. Turn 1 spawns a background agent, turn 2 handles its hand-back notification, turn 3 is a plain turn.

live_resumed_background_agent.description: One background general-purpose agent that ends every run through SubagentHandback and is resumed three times with SendMessage: four completions and three resumes. The issue records no spawn time. One prompt-suggestion helper stop arrives while the third resumed run is working (the helper stops of that session started at 10:35:57).

lost_stop_corrected_by_snapshot.recording: R4; live session s-01M4QC188PWBKPAMVYVZ5CGNQT (stops that never reached the worker)
lost_stop_corrected_by_snapshot.description: Turn 1 spawns a background agent and a background shell; the main Stop lists both. The agent finishes, but its SubagentStop never reaches the worker, as in the live session. Turn 2 spawns a second background agent; its main Stop lists only that agent, because a finished subagent disappears from the next main Stop. The first agent was listed during its run, so its absence settles it as completed while the listed agent stays running.

background_tasks.description: Audit the session journal for stale rows

never_listed_agent_with_only_shells.description: A subagent whose stop never reached the worker is never listed, and each main Stop lists only a background shell. A shell runs no agent, so no live task can hold an unlisted subagent. Claude builds a Stop listing before the hook reads its clock (S4: real Claude 2.1.289 and 2.1.296), so only an earlier main Stop of the same agent proves the subagent had started before a listing was built: the first Stop leaves it running, and the next one settles it as completed.

teammate_keeps_unlisted_agents.recording: R4; Claude Code 2.1.296 binary (in-process teammate task ids differ from their agent ids)
teammate_keeps_unlisted_agents.description: An in-process teammate reports SubagentStart with its `name@team` agent id, while the main Stop lists it as a teammate task under a different task id. Its record is never listed by its own id, and a teammate can host unlisted agents, so it stays running. Once no teammate is live, the next main Stop lists nothing and the record settles as completed.

sync_child_of_background_agent.recording: R4; Claude Code 2.1.296 binary (synchronous children are registered with isBackgrounded false)
sync_child_of_background_agent.description: A background agent spawns a synchronous child, which Claude never lists. The main Stop lists the background agent, which can host unlisted agents, so the child stays running beside it. The child's SubagentStop and then its parent's complete both.

helper_and_snapshot.description: Turn 1 spawns a background agent; its main Stop lists that agent and a second background agent whose SubagentStart never reached the worker, and the prompt-suggestion helper stop follows. Turn 2 handles the hand-back: the agent's SubagentStop, a main Stop that lists nothing, and another helper stop. Helper stops and the listing of an agent without a record create no row.
